item.title: Week 5 - From p5.js to L5, and more Lua
item.description:
Today’s music: Digital Shedding by Eqovil, created with Strudel, selected by Jaiden
shedding is a technique that comes from jazz scenes in regards to practice an endeavor in private to improve one’s proficiency and build your own foundations. all of these clips were made by myself using strudel.cc (as well as vcv for some mels) and most have not been heard by anyone aside me (not even the collaborators mentioned).
